item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 14/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coastal areas of Guangdong in the small hours tomorrow. The associated intense northeast monsoon will bring cold and dry weather to the region in the following couple of days. Under the persistent influence of the monsoon, the weather will be mainly fine over Guangdong in the latter part of next week, but it will still be rather cool in the morning and at night.

Date/Month: 15/01 (Sunday)
Wind: Light winds force 2. Becoming north force 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Foggy with one or two rain patches at first. Temperatures will fall appreciably.
Temp range: 13 - 22 C
R.H. range: 65 - 100 per Cent
PSR: Low
